message: ブラックマロウ！

name: Misa
message: 「Yes! Tomorrow is the big day, so I'm counting on your support\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Haa~~ Making the rounds to greet everyone isn't easy……」
Still, it's amazing how she can flash a smile everywhere she goes.

name: Synn
message: 「You'll be fine if you just relax your shoulders and act natural」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you saying? How rude. I'm acting just like I always do」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if you say so」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly…… Please don't lump me in with how I usually act around you, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, it's different?」

name: Misa
message: 「That is a special side of me that I only show to you」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Special!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, a side I would never, ever show to anyone else……」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa…… Could this possibly be…… *ba-dump*」

name: Misa
message: 「When I think of you, my heart aches, Silent Night」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way……」

name: Misa
message: 「This isn't like you, now's your chance, hurry up and tell him how you feel♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait! I need to mentally prepare myself too--」

name: Misa
message: 「Now, let's have a fair…… showdown!!」

name: Misa
message: 「No good. This poem is rejected」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaaaaaaaat」

name: Misa
message: 「What's with that reaction?」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, you get someone all worked up on your own and then just say 'rejected'--come on!!」

name: Misa
message: 「You do have a point. I forgot to double-check your feelings」

name: Synn
message: 「M-My feelings…… W-Well, that's…… Something like that……\s03」

name: Misa
message: 「What?」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, it's totally out of nowhere, and I can't say something like that yet... it's too embarrassing\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you talking about? Your ears are bright red, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, anyone would end up like this if they suddenly got a confession of love, I'm sure!!」

name: Misa
message: 「L-Love?! Wha--how did you jump to that conclusion?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Because you said I was special to you...」

name: Misa
message: 「I didn't mean it like that!! I only meant I treat you specially as a rival!!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, I see. You should've just said so then... ahaha\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yeah, that's right. Me confessing to you? That wouldn't happen even if heaven and earth turned upside down.」

name: Synn
message: 「R-R-Right, of course~」

name: Misa
message: 「It was my fault too for phrasing it in a misleading way. Things like this should be stated c-l-e-a-r-l-y.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ba-dump...」

name: Misa
message: 「Um... I've kept quiet about it until this very moment, but...」

name: Misa
message: 「I hate you!!」
Sigh... If I keep jumping to weird conclusions like this, she's going to hate me more and more. I've got to be careful.
Wait--so I don't want Misa to hate me... I guess.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it wasn't 'I despise you!!' so I'm still good!」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you convincing yourself of that all on your own?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, how long are you two gonna keep up that lame married-couple routine?」

name: Misa
message: 「We are NOT a married couple!!」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Heeeey.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, Tame-san? I was going to come help haul things in later, though...」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Could really use some extra manpower right about now. Mind coming over for a bit~」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, sure thing! Misa... what should we do?」

name: Misa
message: 「Can't be helped. I'll go check out the other shops in the meantime.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, sorry. Oh, I'll leave my replacement here」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh my!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ugeh」

name: Synn
message: 「See you later!!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-He's out of sight now, isn't he」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-Hey...... Master Synn......」

name: Misa
message: 「Hug!\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gueeeh!!」
Seeing what was being carried out, a shock hit me roughly on par with learning that hamachi and buri are the exact same fish.

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy!?」
Growing this huge in just the short time I wasn't looking--what a terrifying panda!

name: Tame-san
message: 「Ha ha ha. That guy is, uh~~, Buri...... Bra...... Bro...... Oh right, Blackuman~」

name: Synn
message: 「Blackuman...... Oh, that character Misa's crazy about~~」
It looked so much like it that if someone told me Paqy had sprouted right up, I'd probably buy it.
Apparently, this mascot costume was donated to Tame-san's place.

name: Tame-san
message: 「How about this one? Think it'll sell~?」
There's no doubt one particular person would pounce right on it. Still, its size leaves a bit of room for concern. It's way too massive.

name: Synn
message: 「Let me ask around a bit」

name: Misa
message: 「Squeeeeze~~!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah, gah」

name: Misa
message: 「Now, let's head to the next shop, Mr. Paqy\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「S...... Somebody...... help me」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, there she is, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Gyaaah-ta-ta-ta! Don't just call out to me all of a sudden!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry. Actually, I found a real bargain.」

name: Misa
message: 「What is it? Weren't we supposed to be carrying luggage?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's part of that. I wanted you to take a look too, Misa, so come with me.」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yeah.」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-Th-This is~~!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Blackuman.」

name: Misa
message: 「Blackuma!! You don't need the 'n'!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Misa Blackuman Christeles.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Warabi!!」
Paqy was mercilessly slammed against a telephone pole.

name: Paqy
message: 「Throwing me away is cruel, man!」

name: Misa
message: 「You brought it on yourself!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's right. She's the type of woman who dotes on something endlessly, only to toss it out the second it gets dirty. No doubt about it...」

name: Misa
message: 「I would never do that!! Even my plushies from when I was little, I still treasure them--」

name: Synn
message: 「So you really do still have plushies.」

name: Misa
message: 「N-N-No, you've got it wrong!! I do have them, but that's just because I take good care of my things, not because it's a hobby or anything like that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Continuing to use things for a long time... You might actually be pretty similar to me.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't lump me in with you!!」
What am I supposed to do.

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Well then, I guess I'll pass on this mascot costume after all...」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? What do you mean by that?」

name: Synn
message: 「It looked like we could get it for the bazaar, though.」

name: Misa
message: 「By all means, let's take it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh. I knew you'd say that, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on a second. It's not like I'm saying this because I want it for myself. A mascot costume of a popular character is bound to sell. I was merely stating the obvious.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, it is!」

name: Misa
message: 「There's no way I could proudly announce, 'I'll buy it!'--that would be way too embarrassing!」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, this is a once-in-a-lifetime chance... I'll just have to stock it somehow and buy it when nobody's looking.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, Tame-san, I'll head back with this first.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Yeah, sounds good.」

name: Misa
message: 「Until later, then. Please excuse me.\s04」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hahaha! If a young lady like you is gonna dote on it, I'm sure this costume couldn't ask for anything more.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha-wha--!?」
The older gentleman had seen right through her.
